doc.brief: Implements titlebar functionality for a window.
doc.md:
Implements titlebar functionality for a window.

When added into a window, it can be dragged to move the window,
and it implements the right click, double click and middle click
behaviors that are expected of a titlebar.

# CSS nodes

`GtkWindowHandle` has a single CSS node with the name `windowhandle`.

# Accessibility

Until GTK 4.10, `GtkWindowHandle` used the [`AccessibleRole.group`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:group) role.

Starting from GTK 4.12, `GtkWindowHandle` uses the [`AccessibleRole.generic`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:generic)
role.
